title: ALPR search activity compliance & audit records (SOP 205.5.1)
summary:
Asks for the audit records SOP 205.5.1 describes for individual ALPR search activity — operator usage, sign-on information, access dates and times, search-information entry, case-number compliance, and justification linkage.

Distinct in scope from the sharing-configuration audit memos produced under W012129-020926 and W012461-040226.

policy_promises.quote: audits must review operator usage and sign-on information; dates and times of access; entry of required search information by the End-User (case number, etc); and connection between searched data and listed justification
policy_promises.tests: What records address these specific search-activity audit criteria?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012129 produced sharing-configuration audit memos; this request addresses the separate search-activity audits described in SOP 205.5.1.

filed_because: SOP 205.5.1 describes quarterly audits that review individual searches' justification and case-number compliance. The request asks for records of those audits.
notes:
Initial partial denial (2026-03-17) cited Civil Code §1798.90.55(b), Gov. Code §7923.600, and §7927.705.

The request scope is for aggregate compliance metadata (whether required fields were populated) rather than search-result content.

Promised date extended three times; current promise 2026-05-20.
